title: Tabular Data Synthesis for Mixed Data - Experiment Framework
summary: A benchmarking framework, built for a Bachelor thesis, that runs and compares many tabular data augmentation pipelines (PrivBayes, CTABGAN, DP-CTGAN, WGAN-GP, and others) on preprocessed training data, measuring downstream model performance gains. SDV's CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers are imported and instantiated directly as generators, and an in-tree copy of the sdgym benchmarking package (which itself wraps sdv, rdt and sdmetrics) is vendored and invoked as additional baselines.
evidence: framework/samplers.py:431-435 instantiates ctgan.CTGANSynthesizer; framework/generators/sdgym/ is a vendored sdgym copy importing sdv, rdt, sdmetrics
needs: Vendored sdgym tree mixes SDV-family imports (sdv.metadata, rdt, sdmetrics) that are invoked internally by the vendored synthesizers rather than by the author's own code directly; exact call depth not fully traced.
